messages.message: The continuum the peaks in this ROI sit on. "Auto" chooses it after an initial fit, from how well each candidate describes the data.

How the lower and upper energies are used:
Fixed range: they are the ROI's limits.
Lines + peak width: they are the energies of the lowest and highest gamma lines to include (they may be equal, for a single line); the ROI extends past each line based on the detector's peak width and shape, so it adapts to the detector's resolution.
Split by lines: an ROI is made around each significant gamma line in the range, with overlapping ones merged.

How far the ROI extends below its lowest line and above its highest line (for Split by lines, below and above each line it is split around): until that line's peak is covered to the given percent (more than 50 and less than 100), plus the given number of FWHM of continuum. Leave a field empty to use the default for the detector type, shown in grey.

Converts this energy range into individual ROIs, based on which gammas should be grouped together vs apart (e.g., leaves gammas with overlapping peaks in a single ROI, while if two gammas are far apart, they will be split into seperate ROIs.
